mentions.name: Names (poem)
mentions.description: A poem exploring the origin of the author's name, published on the author's poetry website. Written as part of the author's ongoing writing work.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on my writing, of course. In the latest episode of my life, my mother surprised me with fresh news about the origin of my name: https://rikverse2020.rikweb.org.uk/poem/names
